sourceText: 那就通过 Story 把它迁入 docs/requirements/decisions/ 然后开始按照顺序执行
normalizedOutcome: The reviewed plan is promoted into the canonical decisions corpus and made discoverable there; after this migration Story is complete, implementation begins in the plan-defined order through separate Stories.
acceptanceClaim: B-7ffc preserves and links the reviewed plan as an accepted canonical decision without claiming runtime implementation, after which Story 1 is created and started separately.
